widgets.text: Docklands solar trial powers first block

A rooftop solar array on the old grain warehouse began supplying the surrounding block this week, the first shared scheme in the district. Early figures suggest it covers roughly sixty per cent of daytime demand for the four streets around it. Demo summary, not a fetched article.
